A_scene.title: The canal gate

E_blocks.text: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal.
E_blocks.intent: Move from an ordinary journey to recognition of the dead man.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Allow recognition to register without an abrupt expressive flourish.

events.change: Her progress beside the fields is interrupted by a discovery.
The caught body is identified as her brother.

E_blocks.text: She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand.
E_blocks.intent: Express distress through contact rather than an outcry.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the physical response small and deliberate.

events.change: Aruni lowers herself beside Nimal and makes contact with his hand.

E_blocks.text: Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
E_blocks.intent: Give the small object evidentiary weight without explaining its use.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Make the marking legible while preserving the stillness.

events.change: The marked key becomes visible within Nimal's closed hand.

E_blocks.text: Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?
E_blocks.speaker: C02
E_blocks.intent: Appeal for Dinu's attention.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet urgency, with emotion held back.

events.change: Aruni directs a verbal appeal toward the absent Dinu.

E_blocks.text: She calls Dinu. No answer.
E_blocks.intent: Deny immediate contact or reassurance.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Let the unanswered attempt linger.

events.change: An attempt to contact Dinu produces no response.

E_blocks.text: A distant bus horn mixes with the rain.
E_blocks.intent: Leave the surrounding world audible against her isolation.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the remote traffic sound embedded in the weather.

events.change: A remote vehicle signal joins the rain ambience.

E_blocks.text: Cut to black.
E_blocks.intent: End the discovery before any explanation arrives.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: A clean visual stop.

E_blocks.text: TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.
E_blocks.intent: Present the episode's title after the unanswered appeal.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the title separate from the preceding image.

G_direction.text:
Village palette - Warm amber and earthy red. Locked-off frames, natural light and longer
silences.
Lighting - Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
Editing - Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.

Sound - Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero
elevation moments.
Slow motion - Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
The action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence.
Dinu is not an invincible superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing.

Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the final victory comes from the recording, the
village and their courage - not from violence alone.

She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE:
EKAMA SAKSHIYA.
G_direction.moment_here: Aruni calls Dinu without an answer; a distant horn mixes with rain before the cut to black and title.

A_scene.heading: SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
A_scene.title: The redirected van
A_scene.summary: Dinu hears Aruni's concern about Nimal while driving. Mudalali then orders a different destination, and Dinu changes course after looking at his wrist thread.
A_scene.purpose: Bring personal concern and an employer's demand into the same journey without establishing a causal link between them.

E_blocks.text: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van.
E_blocks.intent: Establish Dinu at work within the wet city.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the driving contained rather than presenting it as a chase.

E_blocks.text: On the dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop.
E_blocks.intent: Establish an existing personal bond through a keepsake.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Let the photograph register without treating the pictured people as present.

events.change: A dashboard photograph associates Dinu and Aruni with a shared village memory.

E_blocks.text: Aruni's voice message plays.
E_blocks.intent: Bring Aruni into the journey through recorded audio.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Distinguish playback from a live exchange.

E_blocks.text: Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan baya hithenawa.
E_blocks.speaker: C02
E_blocks.intent: Report Nimal's continued absence and seek support.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Controlled concern that becomes more openly fearful.

events.change: Dinu learns that Nimal has not returned and that Aruni is afraid.

E_blocks.text: Mudalali calls.
E_blocks.intent: Interrupt the personal concern with a work demand.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the arrival of the call matter-of-fact.

events.change: Mudalali initiates contact with Dinu.

E_blocks.text: Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna.

E_blocks.intent: Order a route change to a different destination.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Brief and authoritative.

events.change: Dinu receives instructions replacing his existing route.

E_blocks.text: Dinu looks at the red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.
E_blocks.intent: Connect a private moment of attention with the subsequent change of course without explaining the thread.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Give the wrist glance a readable beat before the turn.

events.change: Dinu glances at the thread and steers toward the industrial district.

A_scene.heading: SCENE 03 - FLASHBACK - INT. COLOMBO GARAGE - 2 MINUTES
A_scene.title: The garage handoff
A_scene.summary: Earlier, Nimal presents material concerning Mudalali's money. Dinu objects to taking it, but Nimal presses him through his relationship with Aruni and places the key in his hand.
A_scene.purpose: Establish the key's earlier custody and Dinu's moral resistance without resolving whether he accepts Nimal's proposal.

summary.value:
Six hours earlier. Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the
C-17 key.

something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal. She does not scream. She kneels
and touches his hand. Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.

A Colombo cash-transfer driver steals Rs. 300 million after witnessing his closest friend's
murder, then returns to his village with the woman he loves to expose the corrupt network that
destroyed them.

E_blocks.text: Six hours earlier.
E_blocks.intent: Move the chronology backward relative to the van journey.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Make the temporal shift clear without adding a new event.

E_blocks.text: Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the C-17 key.
E_blocks.intent: Present tangible support for Nimal's proposal.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Make the contents readable without inventing their details.

events.change: Opening the container exposes the key alongside photographic and financial material.

E_blocks.text: Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.
E_blocks.speaker: C03
E_blocks.intent: Identify the money and justify targeting it through its alleged origin.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Direct and certain.

events.change: Nimal attributes the money to Mudalali's extraction from village development work.

E_blocks.text: Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.
E_blocks.speaker: C01
E_blocks.intent: Reject the moral distinction Nimal uses to support taking the money.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet but firm.

events.change: Dinu explicitly challenges the proposed taking.

E_blocks.text: Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa oyawa atharinnawa.
E_blocks.speaker: C03
E_blocks.intent: Shift the argument from money to Dinu's fear and attachment to Aruni.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Personal and pressing rather than reassuring.

events.change: Nimal uses the possibility of losing Aruni to challenge Dinu's hesitation.

E_blocks.text: Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand.
E_blocks.intent: Make the entrustment physical without treating it as agreement.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Show a deliberate handoff at normal speed.

events.change: The key passes from Nimal into Dinu's hand.

E_blocks.text: Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.
E_blocks.intent: Leave Dinu's decision unresolved.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Hold his attention on the object beneath the roof's rain ambience.

events.change: Dinu studies the key without a stated commitment.
Rain remains audible against the roof during the pause.
